eyebrow: Dedup, cast, filter -- in one pass
code:
bronze_df = spark.table("bronze.daily_sales_raw")

silver_df = (
    bronze_df
    .dropDuplicates(["order_id", "line_number"])
    .withColumn("sale_date", to_date(col("sale_date")))
    .withColumn("sales_amount",
        col("sales_amount").cast("decimal(12,2)"))
    .filter(col("store_id").isNotNull()
        & col("sale_date").isNotNull()
        & col("sales_amount").isNotNull())
)
caption: Named business key, explicit types, required columns enforced.
